title: The Two Closest Values
statement:
Among `n` numbers, find the smallest difference `|a_i - a_j|` over all pairs of different positions `i != j`. Equal values at different positions give a difference of `0`.

## Input
The first line contains `n`. The second line contains `n` integers.

## Output
Print the smallest absolute difference between two numbers at different positions.

## Constraints
- `2 <= n <= 60000`
- `-10^9 <= a_i <= 10^9`
